cleaner.label: Codex
cleaner.description: Cache and factory-wipe cleaners for OpenAI Codex CLI

option.label: Cache
option.description: Delete Codex CLI caches, logs, and temporary files.
option.warning: Close Codex before cleaning. This preserves config, auth, and history.

option.label: Factory wipe
option.description: Delete all Codex CLI local state.
option.warning: This removes Codex config, auth, history, logs, sessions, and caches. You may need to log in again.
